name: Levels & XP
summary: Everyone starts at Level 0. Here is how the levels come.

sections.heading: Ways to earn XP
sections.body:
- Villager quests and notice-board bounties pay XP and cash.
- Vampires earn by feeding; humans by hunting.
- Vampires can sleep (**B**) for slow, AFK XP. Boosts don't affect sleep XP.
- Mining: 3 XP for coal, 6 for silver, 9 for ruby, before multipliers. See [[mining]].
- A [[blood-moon]] gives more XP for killing NPCs.
- Witches can set a [[level-grinding-ritual]]: 1 level every 15 minutes.
- A vampire's [[vampire|Bloodline]] passes its founder 50% of its members' XP.
- The rare [[beast-form-vampire]] is worth a lot of XP.

sections.heading: XP boosts
sections.body:
Boosts last 30 minutes each. You buy them or get them from [[redeeming-codes|codes]], and they stack with the [[double-xp-weekend]].

- 2× XP: 295 Robux (266 with Plus)
- 3× XP: 495 Robux (446 with Plus)
- 4× XP: 795 Robux (716 with Plus)

sections.heading: Rank ladders
sections.body: Witches have a full ladder from Novice to Scarce: see [[witch]]. A vampire ladder is reported but disputed: see [[vampire]].
